title.zh: 猜对一次，不证明特殊能力

paragraphs.en: Imagine that two people receive eleven. One notices a scheduling problem before it is explained; the other misunderstands a brief message and later changes their view. Neither outcome demonstrates how well the number fits. A useful guess may come from specific experience, visible clues or chance, and a mistaken reading can happen even in a familiar situation. Remembering only the guesses that worked would make the label seem more informative than the evidence allows. You can credit a good observation without assigning yourself a permanent gift, and you can correct a misunderstanding without deciding that you have failed a symbolic identity. The relevant evidence belongs to the situation, not the calculation.
paragraphs.zh: 假设两个人都算出十一。一个在解释出现前注意到排期问题，另一个误解了一条短消息，后来修正看法。哪种结果都不能证明数字有多贴合。一次有用的猜测，可能来自具体经验、可见线索，也可能碰巧猜中；熟悉场景里也会有误读。只记住猜中的部分，会让标签显得比证据允许的更有信息量。可以肯定一次好观察，而不授予自己永久天赋；也可以改正误解，而不认定自己辜负了某种符号身份。有关证据属于真实情况，而非运算。

title.en: Try one low-stakes clarification
title.zh: 试着澄清一件小事

paragraphs.en: If you want to use the motif, choose a low-stakes message or plan that you can discuss comfortably. Make a private note of the exact information, your first reading and one alternative explanation. Then decide whether a simple clarification would be useful. You may ask a neutral question, look for an agreed detail or decide that no action is needed. There is no requirement to investigate every reaction, challenge another person or turn the exercise into a score. Avoid using it to override clear boundaries or to make an urgent decision wait for a symbolic sign. Any notes can remain with you; the website does not need the message or the people involved.
paragraphs.zh: 如果想借用这个主题，可以选一条方便讨论、影响较小的消息或安排，私下记下原始信息、第一种读法，以及一种其他解释。随后再决定，简单澄清是否有帮助：可以问一个中性问题，查看已约定的细节，也可以判断无需行动。不必调查每一次反应、质疑别人，或把练习变成分数；更不应用它越过明确边界，或让紧急决定等待某种符号。笔记可以留在自己手中，网站不需要接收消息原文或涉及的人物信息。

title.en: Why eleven and two can exchange places
title.zh: 为什么十一与二可能互换

paragraphs.en: For the fictional date 1980-01-01, the separate-parts rule reduces the year through 18 to 9, then gives 9 + 1 + 1 = 11. The all-date-digits rule starts with a total of 20 and reduces it to 2. Reducing the year before combining it with the month and day changes the totals reached, even though both calculations use the same date and stopping rule. Adding decimal digits preserves the remainder modulo nine, which is why eleven and two share the same digital root. This relationship is arithmetic. It does not make eleven a more advanced version of two, nor does a change of method reveal a previously hidden level of a person's intuition.
paragraphs.zh: 虚构日期1980-01-01，在分部分法中把年份经18化简为9，再算9＋1＋1＝11；全日期数字法先得到20，再化简为2。先化简年份再与月份、日期相加，会改变实际经过的总和；即使日期和停止规则相同，终点也可能不同。十进制各位相加会保留除以九的余数，这也说明十一与二具有相同数字根。这个联系属于算术，不会使十一成为二的进阶版本；换一种方法，也不会揭露某个人此前隐藏的直觉层级。

title.en: The motif belongs to this guide
title.zh: 主题属于本篇指南

paragraphs.en: Numerology.com and lmp.jp document the selected arithmetic conventions. FermatMind wrote the impression-and-checking motif, message scene and optional prompts independently. They are editorial material rather than findings that a birthday predicts perception, empathy or unusual awareness. The public guide needs no personal date. If you use a calculator and share its symbolic label, keep the detailed trace private when you prefer not to reveal the input: even intermediate sums can disclose parts of a date. You may choose another motif or leave the story aside. An impression can be worth noticing, while its meaning remains something to examine through the available evidence and the people concerned.
paragraphs.zh: Numerology.com与lmp.jp记录了所选算术约定；印象与核对的主题、消息情境及可选提示，由费马独立编写。这些是编辑内容，而不是生日能够预测知觉、共情或特殊感知的研究结论。公开指南不需要个人日期。若使用计算器并分享符号标签，而又不想透露输入，可以把详细步骤留作私人信息：即使中间总和，也可能暴露日期的部分信息。你可以选择其他主题，或把故事放在一边。一个印象值得被注意，它意味着什么，仍然可以依据现有证据及有关当事人的说明继续理解。

title.en: Number Eleven: Impressions & Calculation Guide
title.zh: 数字十一：印象核对与计算读法

description.en: Explore eleven as an optional story about noticing an impression, then checking it. Follow the arithmetic and compare eleven with two without a hierarchy.
description.zh: 把十一当作看见印象、再核对依据的可选故事。跟随运算，阅读情境与反例，并理解十一与二的关系，而不设高低层级。

title.en: Twenty-two: a plan others can use
title.zh: 二十二：让别人用得上的计划

headline.en: Twenty-two: a plan others can use
headline.zh: 二十二：让别人用得上的计划

summary.en: Use twenty-two as a story about turning a small shared plan into something people can use, question and change. Let feedback shape the next draft.
summary.zh: 把二十二当作让共享计划变得可用、可提问、可调整的故事，让反馈参与下一稿。

scoreReading.en: Twenty-two is a retained arithmetic endpoint, not a measure of leadership or a requirement to build something large.
scoreReading.zh: 二十二是被保留的运算终点，不测领导力，也不要求完成宏大事业。

title.en: A plan becomes useful when others can use it
title.zh: 别人用得上，计划才开始发挥作用

paragraphs.en: Imagine making a small plan and then watching someone else try to use it. Twenty-two holds that editorial image: bringing an idea into a form that other people can understand, question and change. The label does not establish exceptional leadership, practical talent or a duty to build something large. A useful plan might be a few clear instructions for a shared task. It can be unfinished, modest and revised after a first attempt. The point of this motif is the meeting between a plan and its users. Their actual needs and feedback provide information that the birthday calculation cannot supply, including whether the plan is wanted at all.
paragraphs.zh: 想象写好一个小计划，再看看别人怎样使用。本篇用“二十二”承载这个编辑画面：把想法变成别人能够理解、提问和修改的形式。标签不证明卓越领导力、实践天赋，也不要求建立什么宏大事业。有用的计划，可能只是几条清楚的共享任务说明；它可以尚未完善、规模很小，并在第一次尝试后调整。主题关注的是计划与使用者的相遇。他们的真实需要和反馈，提供生日运算无法给出的信息，也包括这个计划究竟有没有人需要。

title.en: A fictional date with two routes to twenty-two
title.zh: 一个通过两条路径得到二十二的虚构日期

paragraphs.en: For the fictional date 2000-09-29, the separate-parts rule reduces the year to 2, keeps the month as 9 and reduces the day through 2 + 9 = 11. Eleven is retained under the selected convention. The final addition is therefore 2 + 9 + 11 = 22, another retained endpoint. The all-date-digits rule gives 2 + 0 + 0 + 0 + 0 + 9 + 2 + 9 = 22 directly. Both routes stop there. The intermediate operations matter to reproducibility; they do not assess whether someone can organise a project. Twenty-two remains an arithmetic label even when the scene in this guide happens to feel familiar.
paragraphs.zh: 虚构日期2000-09-29，在分部分法中把年份化简为2，月份保留9，日期则经2＋9得到11；所选约定保留十一，所以最后算2＋9＋11＝22，停在另一个被保留的终点。全日期数字法直接算2＋0＋0＋0＋0＋9＋2＋9＝22，也在这里停止。中间步骤对复算很重要，却不能评估一个人是否善于组织项目。即使本篇情境恰好让人熟悉，二十二仍然只是运算标签。

title.en: Make a shared watering plan someone can follow
title.zh: 做一份别人能够接手的浇水安排

paragraphs.en: Suppose neighbours agree to look after a few shared planters. A beautiful timetable is not enough if nobody knows which plants need attention or what to do when a person is away. The group could label the planters, agree how to check the soil and keep a simple record of who last watered them. They can also choose a way to report a problem and decide who can change the schedule. Trying the arrangement for a short period may reveal that one instruction is unclear or that less watering is needed. The useful outcome is a plan people can actually follow and adjust, rather than proof that its author has a particular kind of personality.
paragraphs.zh: 假设邻居们同意照看几盆共用植物。漂亮的时间表并不够：大家还要知道哪些需要留意、有人外出时怎么办。可以给花盆做标记，约定怎样查看土壤，并简单记录上次由谁浇水；也可以决定怎样反馈问题、谁能调整排期。短期试行后，可能发现某条说明不清楚，或实际需要更少的浇水。有用的结果，是大家真正能执行和调整的安排，而不是证明制订者拥有某种人格。

title.en: Let the users change the first draft
title.zh: 让使用者有机会修改初稿

paragraphs.en: A plan written by one person can contain assumptions that are invisible to its author. Someone may not be available at the expected time, able to reach a planter or comfortable using the chosen app. Asking about those constraints before assigning tasks can prevent a tidy document from becoming an unwanted obligation. Feedback can also show that a simpler method would work better. You do not have to defend every detail to show that you took the task seriously. Equally, receiving feedback does not oblige you to keep managing the arrangement forever. Clarify which changes are possible, who agrees to them and when the group will review whether the plan remains useful.
paragraphs.zh: 一个人写的计划，可能包含自己没有察觉的假设：别人也许无法在预计时间出现、够不到某盆植物，或不习惯指定应用。分配任务前先了解限制，可以避免整齐的文档变成别人不愿承担的义务。反馈也可能说明，更简单的方法反而好用。无需捍卫每个细节来证明自己认真；收到反馈，也不代表必须永远管理下去。可以说明哪些部分可改、由谁同意，以及何时再看看安排是否仍然有用。

title.en: A useful plan need not be a large achievement
title.zh: 有用的安排，无需成为重大成就

paragraphs.en: Imagine two people who both receive twenty-two. One enjoys making a written plan; the other prefers to help with a specific task after someone else organises it. Neither is a better or worse expression of the label. Skills, available time, interest and the arrangement itself may explain the difference. A plan can also fail because conditions change, even when its author has worked carefully. The number cannot distinguish those causes or promise that persistence will solve them. You can value a small contribution, abandon an unnecessary document or choose a different role without treating it as a missed destiny. The size of a project does not determine the worth of the person involved.
paragraphs.zh: 假设两个人都算出二十二。一个喜欢写计划，另一个更愿意在别人组织后承担具体任务。没有哪一种更好或更差地“体现标签”；技能、可用时间、兴趣及安排本身，都可能解释差异。即使制订者十分认真，条件变化也可能使计划失效。数字无法区分这些原因，也不能保证坚持就能解决。可以重视小贡献、放下不必要的文档，或选择别的角色，无需把它视为错过命定任务。项目规模也不决定参与者的价值。

title.en: Test one instruction with a willing reader
title.zh: 请愿意参与的人试读一条说明

paragraphs.en: If you want to try the motif, choose a small shared task and write one instruction that would let another willing person begin. Ask what they would need to know before acting, and invite them to point out an unclear term or missing step. You can revise the instruction together or decide that a written plan adds little. This is a voluntary design exercise, not a test of intelligence, influence or commitment. Use a task that you are authorised to arrange, avoid including private information and do not assign someone a responsibility they have not accepted. The result can stay in your own notes. There is no required output for the website to collect.
paragraphs.zh: 如果想试用主题，可以选一件小型共享任务，写一条让愿意参与的人能够开始的说明，再问对方行动前还需要知道什么，并邀请其指出不清楚的词或遗漏步骤。可以一起改写，也可以判断书面计划帮助不大。这是自愿的设计练习，不测智力、影响力或投入程度。应选择自己有权安排的事，避开私人信息，也不把责任交给尚未同意的人。结果可以留在自己的笔记里，网站无需收取任何指定产出。

title.en: Twenty-two and four share a digital root
title.zh: 二十二与四具有相同数字根

paragraphs.en: If twenty-two were reduced again, 2 + 2 would give 4. The selected rules instead retain it when their stopping condition is reached. Differences in when a component or combined sum is reduced can make the two methods return twenty-two and four for the same date. They still preserve the same digital root because decimal digit sums preserve the remainder modulo nine. This connection explains why the labels can be paired in a comparison. It does not make twenty-two a superior form of four or establish that the two describe related psychological traits. Read the displayed calculation to understand the result, and use the motifs only as optional stories.
paragraphs.zh: 若把二十二继续化简，2＋2会得到4；所选规则则在满足停止条件时保留它。对日期组成部分或合计值何时化简的不同处理，可能使两种方法为同一日期分别得到二十二与四。两者仍保留相同数字根，因为十进制各位相加保留除以九的余数。这个联系说明标签为何可以成对比较，却不会让二十二成为四的优越形式，也不证明它们描述了相关心理特征。可以查看展示的运算来理解结果，主题则只作为可选故事使用。

title.en: A practical story with an arithmetic boundary
title.zh: 实用故事，也保留算术边界

paragraphs.en: Numerology.com and lmp.jp document the two selected calculation conventions. FermatMind independently wrote the shared-plan motif, planter example and reflection prompts. Those editorial choices do not establish a connection between birth dates and leadership, income, achievement or future responsibilities. No personal date is needed to read the public guide. A calculator input and its detailed operations can remain private; sharing a symbolic label does not require revealing a date or the steps that may reconstruct it. You can use an ordinary planning idea even if you reject the number's story, or enjoy the story without undertaking a project. Real agreements depend on the people who will use and maintain them.
paragraphs.zh: Numerology.com与lmp.jp记录了两种所选运算约定；共享计划主题、花盆案例和反思提示，由费马独立编写。这些编辑选择，不证明出生日期与领导力、收入、成就或未来责任有关。阅读公开指南不需要个人日期；计算器输入和详细步骤可以保持私密，分享一个符号标签，不要求同时透露日期或可能反推出日期的步骤。可以拒绝数字故事，却借用一个普通的计划方法；也可以享受故事，而不承担项目。现实中的约定，取决于真正使用与维护它的人。

title.en: Number Twenty-two: Shared Plans & Calculation Guide
title.zh: 数字二十二：共享计划与计算读法

description.en: Explore twenty-two as an optional story about a plan others can use. Follow a fictional calculation and compare twenty-two with four without ranking people.
description.zh: 把二十二当作让别人用得上计划的可选故事。跟随虚构运算，阅读情境与反例，比较二十二与四，而不对人作等级判断。

title.en: Thirty-three: share experience with clear limits
title.zh: 三十三：有边界地分享经验

headline.en: Thirty-three: share experience with clear limits
headline.zh: 三十三：有边界地分享经验

summary.en: Use thirty-three as a story about sharing a requested piece of knowledge. Make room for questions, honest limits and the other person’s choice.
summary.zh: 把三十三当作分享一份对方确实想了解的知识的故事，留出提问、诚实边界和对方选择的空间。

scoreReading.en: Thirty-three is a retained arithmetic endpoint, not a measure of compassion, teaching skill or a duty to serve.
scoreReading.zh: 三十三是被保留的运算终点，不测共情或教学能力，也不设置服务他人的义务。

title.en: Share what you know without taking over
title.zh: 分享所知，也给别人留下空间

paragraphs.en: Imagine knowing how to do a small thing that someone else wants to learn. Thirty-three holds the editorial image of sharing that experience while keeping the help wanted, limited and open to questions. The number does not appoint anyone a teacher, healer or source of wisdom. You can know one useful technique without being responsible for another person's whole experience. You can also be the learner in the next conversation. The motif begins with the other person's request and with what you can honestly offer. Whether help is useful depends on that exchange, not on a label produced from either person's birthday.
paragraphs.zh: 想象你会做一件小事，而另一个人正想学习。本篇用“三十三”承载这样的编辑画面：分享经验，同时让帮助建立在对方愿意、范围清楚、能够提问的基础上。数字不任命谁成为教师、疗愈者或智慧来源。会一种实用方法，不代表要对别人的全部体验负责；下一场交流中，自己也可能是学习者。主题从对方的请求，以及自己确实能提供什么开始。帮助有没有用，取决于这次交流，而非任何一人的生日标签。

title.en: A fictional date that separates the methods
title.zh: 一个让两种方法分开的虚构日期

paragraphs.en: For the fictional date 2009-11-11, the separate-parts rule reduces the year through 2 + 0 + 0 + 9 = 11 and retains it. The month and day are also retained as 11. Adding the parts gives 11 + 11 + 11 = 33, so that method stops at thirty-three. The all-date-digits method instead totals 15 and continues to 6. Both calculations follow their selected rules. Neither result identifies a more advanced person or a truer purpose. The different endpoints arise from intermediate stopping rules, so the method should remain visible whenever a calculator presents a label. Reading the public guide itself requires no personal date.
paragraphs.zh: 虚构日期2009-11-11，在分部分法中把年份经2＋0＋0＋9得到11并保留，月份与日期也各自保留11；再算11＋11＋11＝33，停在三十三。全日期数字法则先得到15，再化简为6。两次运算都符合各自所选规则；任何一个结果，都不识别更高级的人或更真实的使命。终点不同来自中间停止规则，因此计算器展示标签时，也应让使用的方法保持可见。阅读公开指南本身，无需提供个人日期。

title.en: Explain one round of a game
title.zh: 把一轮游戏讲清楚

paragraphs.en: Suppose a friend asks how to play a board game you enjoy. You could ask whether they want a quick demonstration or a written explanation, show one ordinary turn and let them try the next. If a rule is unfamiliar to you, look it up rather than inventing an answer to protect the role of expert. Your friend may prefer another explanation or decide the game is not for them. Those responses give you information about the activity; they are not a verdict on your worth. The useful contribution is a clear, requested explanation of a bounded task, with room for the learner to choose what happens next.
paragraphs.zh: 假设朋友询问你喜欢的一款桌游怎么玩。可以先问对方想看快速演示，还是书面说明，再示范普通的一轮，让其试下一轮。遇到自己也不熟悉的规则，可以一起查，而非为了维持专家形象编出答案。朋友可能偏好另一种讲法，也可能决定不玩；这些反应说明活动是否适合，不是对你个人价值的裁决。有用的贡献，是把一个范围有限、对方确实想了解的任务讲清，并给学习者留下下一步的选择空间。

title.en: Name the edge of your experience
title.zh: 说清自己经验的边界

paragraphs.en: Experience with one game does not establish expertise in every version, every group or every kind of learning. Even a familiar explanation may need adjusting when someone uses different equipment, language or accessibility support. You can ask what would help and be honest when you do not know. You can also say how much time you have, point to an appropriate source or decline a request that is outside your role. Clear limits make the offer easier to understand; they do not cancel generosity. The motif does not turn personal experience into professional advice, and it does not require someone receiving help to follow a suggestion because you meant well.
paragraphs.zh: 熟悉一款游戏，不等于精通每个版本、每个群体或每种学习方式。即使熟练的解释，遇到不同设备、语言或无障碍需要，也可能要调整。可以问什么会有帮助，也可以坦言不知道；还可以说明可用时间、指出合适来源，或拒绝超出角色的请求。清楚的边界让提议更易理解，不会抵消善意。主题不把个人经验变成专业建议，也不要求接受帮助的人仅因你的出发点良好就照做。

title.en: Learning can be a contribution too
title.zh: 愿意学习，也可以是一种参与

paragraphs.en: Imagine two people who both receive thirty-three at a game evening. One explains a rule clearly; the other admits they are unsure and asks a question that reveals an ambiguity in the instructions. Both actions may help the group. Neither proves the meaning of the number, and neither creates a permanent teaching role. Someone who wants to play quietly, rest or leave early is also allowed to do so. A symbolic guide cannot determine how much anyone owes to a group. Notice the actual request, skill and available energy rather than using the label to praise endless service or to criticise someone for needing support themselves.
paragraphs.zh: 假设游戏聚会中，两个人都算出三十三。一个把规则讲清，另一个承认不确定，并提出问题，让大家发现说明书的歧义。两种行为都可能有帮助；它们既不证明数字含义，也不建立永久教学角色。想安静玩、休息或提前离开，也都可以。符号指南无法决定谁欠群体多少付出。可以留意实际请求、技能与余力，而不使用标签歌颂无止境服务，或批评一个同样需要支持的人。

title.en: Offer one small explanation with permission
title.zh: 征得意愿，再分享一个小方法

paragraphs.en: If the motif interests you, think of one low-stakes skill that a willing person has actually asked about. Offer a short example and ask which part, if any, they want to try. Agree how long you will spend and leave space for a different preference. Afterwards, you can consider whether the explanation answered the question or needed a clearer step. You are not measuring your ability to inspire people, and the other person does not owe you enthusiasm. Keep the task within your real knowledge and role. There is no need to collect feedback as a personal score or send names, messages or private details to the website.
paragraphs.zh: 如果主题有吸引力，可以想到一种影响较小、而且确实有人愿意了解的小技能，提供一个简短示例，再问对方想试哪部分，或是否想试。约定花多少时间，也容许不同偏好。之后可以想想，说明有没有回答原问题，或哪一步需要更清楚。这里不测鼓舞他人的能力，对方也不欠你热烈反应。任务应在真实知识与角色范围内；无需把反馈收集成人格分数，也无需把姓名、消息或私人细节交给网站。

title.en: The other method can also retain thirty-three
title.zh: 另一种方法，同样可能保留三十三

paragraphs.en: The difference does not mean that only the separate-parts method can return thirty-three. For the fictional date 1990-09-23, all eight date digits add to 33, so the all-date-digits rule retains it. The separate-parts rule reduces the year to 1, keeps the month as 9 and reduces the day to 5, giving 15 and then 6. These two examples show opposite directions of the 33 and 6 difference. They share a digital root because 3 + 3 = 6. That arithmetic relationship is not a ranking of compassion, teaching skill or responsibility, and the frequency of an endpoint supplies no evidence of an exceptional destiny.
paragraphs.zh: 这种差异不意味着只有分部分法能得到三十三。虚构日期1990-09-23的八个数字相加为33，所以全日期数字法保留它；分部分法则把年份化简为1，月份保留9，日期化简为5，合计15，再得到6。两个例子展示了33与6差异的相反方向。因为3＋3＝6，它们具有相同数字根；这项算术联系，不是共情、教学技能或责任感的排名，某个终点出现的频率，也不能证明特殊命运。

title.en: An optional story about sharing experience
title.zh: 一个关于分享经验的可选故事

paragraphs.en: Numerology.com and lmp.jp document the selected calculation conventions. FermatMind independently wrote this sharing-experience motif, the game example and the optional exercise. These are editorial choices, not evidence that birthdays predict compassion, professional competence or a duty to help. You may share a symbolic label while keeping a calculator's date and operation trace private; the trace can disclose details about the input. You can also read the guide without calculating anything. A useful explanation can come from any person who has relevant knowledge and permission to offer it. Its quality is better judged by the actual question, the accuracy of the information and the recipient's choices than by the number attached to a story.
paragraphs.zh: Numerology.com与lmp.jp记录了所选运算约定；分享经验主题、游戏案例和可选练习，由费马独立编写。这些是编辑选择，不是生日能预测共情、专业能力或帮助义务的证据。分享符号标签时，可以把计算器日期与运算步骤留作私人信息，因为步骤可能暴露输入细节；也可以完全不计算，只阅读指南。任何具备有关知识、并获对方同意的人，都可能提供有用解释。解释质量，更适合依据实际问题、信息准确性与接受者的选择来判断，而非故事所附的数字。

title.en: Number Thirty-three: Sharing Experience & Calculation Guide
title.zh: 数字三十三：经验分享与计算读法

description.en: Explore thirty-three as an optional story about sharing experience with clear limits. Compare worked examples for thirty-three and six under both methods.
description.zh: 把三十三当作有边界地分享经验的可选故事。比较两种方法得到三十三与六的完整算例，阅读情境、反例和自愿练习。

title.en: Reduce the parts, then combine
title.zh: 先分别化简，再合计

paragraphs.en: Reduce each of month, day and year to one digit or 11, 22, 33; combine the parts and use the same rule again.
paragraphs.zh: 把月、日、年分别化简到个位或11、22、33；合计后，再使用同样规则。

title.en: Add all date digits, then reduce
title.zh: 先合计日期各位，再化简

paragraphs.en: Add the eight YYYYMMDD digits first; keep reducing until one digit or 11, 22, 33. A total of 44 reduces to 8.
paragraphs.zh: 先合计YYYYMMDD的八个数字，再继续化简到个位或11、22、33。总和44会化简为8。

title.en: What is shared or saved?
title.zh: 会保存或分享什么？

paragraphs.en: Your date and detailed operations stay in the current page while it is open. Clearing, reloading or changing language removes them. A copy action includes only the symbolic label and method, because calculation steps may reveal parts of the date.
paragraphs.zh: 日期与详细运算只留在打开的当前页面中；清除、重载或切换语言会移除。复制功能只包含符号标签和方法，因为计算步骤可能透露日期的一部分。

title.en: Does a number describe my personality or future?
title.zh: 数字会描述我的人格或未来吗？

paragraphs.en: No. This is a transparent symbolic calculation and a collection of optional stories, not a validated personality measure or a prediction. The motifs, examples and prompts are independently written FermatMind editorial content.
paragraphs.zh: 不会。本页提供透明的符号运算和可选故事，不是经过验证的人格测量或预测。主题、案例和提示均为费马独立编写的编辑内容。

question.en: Why can the two methods give different numbers?
question.zh: 两种方法为什么可能得到不同数字？

answer.en: The separate-parts method reduces the month, day and year before adding them. The all-date-digits method adds all eight digits first. Both retain 11, 22 and 33 at their selected stopping points. Different intermediate stopping points can produce 11 versus 2, 22 versus 4 or 33 versus 6; the methods preserve the same digital root.
answer.zh: 分部分法先化简年月日，再合计；全日期数字法先把八个数字相加。两法都在各自指定停点保留11、22和33。不同的中间停止处理，可能产生11与2、22与4或33与6的差异；两法保留相同数字根。

question.en: Does a number describe my personality or future?
question.zh: 数字会描述我的人格或未来吗？

answer.en: No. This is a transparent symbolic calculation and a collection of optional stories, not a validated personality measure or a prediction. The motifs, examples and prompts are independently written FermatMind editorial content.

question.en: Is the birthday Soul Number the same as a name-based Soul Urge?
question.zh: 生日灵数与按姓名元音计算的Soul Urge一样吗？

answer.en: Here the all-date-digits option uses only a Gregorian calendar date. It is the birthday-based method selected from a Japanese operator. It does not request a name or vowels. Names for numerology methods vary between publishers; this page labels the actual operations.
answer.zh: 本页的一并相加选项只用公历日期，是从一家日本运营方选定的生日算法，不收集姓名或元音字母。不同发布者对数字命理方法的命名并不统一，本页以实际操作说明方法。

answer.en: Enter the Gregorian calendar date you choose to calculate, using the labelled year, month and day fields. No birth time, birthplace, gender or name is needed. Invalid calendar dates stay invalid; the calculator does not roll them into another month or infer a time zone.
answer.zh: 使用有标签的年月日字段，输入想计算的公历日期。不需要出生时间、地点、性别或姓名。无效日期会明确报错，不会自动滚入下月，也不推测时区。

answer.en: Your date and detailed operations stay in the current page while it is open. Clearing, reloading or changing language removes them. A copy action includes only the symbolic label and method, because calculation steps may reveal parts of the date.
answer.zh: 日期与详细运算只留在打开的当前页面中；清除、重载或切换语言会移除。复制功能只包含符号标签和方法，因为计算步骤可能透露日期的一部分。

question.en: Why are there twelve shared guides?
question.zh: 为什么共用十二篇指南？

answer.en: The selected rules can finish at 1–9, 11, 22 or 33. Both methods use the same twelve original motifs; the arithmetic explanation changes with the selected method. A second method does not create a second personality or another twelve independent interpretations.
answer.zh: 所选规则会停在1—9、11、22或33。两法共用十二个原创主题，运算说明随所选方法变化。第二种方法不产生第二种人格，也不另算十二篇独立解释。
